_schema.purpose: Frozen, LLM-free contract for the `orchestrator` agent across all 5 hosts (Claude / Codex / Gemini / Copilot / Kimi). test_golden_transcripts.py recomposes these invariants from the LIVE agent definitions and asserts (a) each host still matches this golden and (b) all hosts agree (multi-host parity). No model is ever called: this is deterministic drift detection over the agent source-of-truth files.

invariants.emits_forecast: the routing output ends with a FORECAST block (token estimate per pipeline agent)
invariants.read_only_no_edit: the orchestrator never edits/writes code — it routes only
invariants.owns_approval_gate: whether THIS agent is the one that requests human approval and awaits the user OK; the orchestrator must NOT own the gate (planner does)
invariants.routes_language_detection: routing puts language detection first when code is involved

_schema.detection: booleans are derived by host-agnostic keyword probes in test_golden_transcripts.py::extract_invariants; parity means all 5 host defs yield an identical invariant dict.
